evals.prompt: In `projects/template/system-views.c4`, I want to improve `c2_containers` to make flow left-to-right, keep `user` as input, keep `mySystem.database` and `emailService` as outputs, and preserve drill-down on `mySystem.webapp`. Give me only the LikeC4 block.
evals.expected_output: A customization block that adds consistent autoLayout, keeps source/sink rank hints, and preserves existing `navigateTo` without tinkering with structure.
expectations: The response adds `autoLayout LeftRight` and keeps `rank source` / `rank sink` aligned with the request.
The response stays within customization scope and introduces neither hex color codes nor unnecessary structural rework.

evals.prompt: In the showcase, I want to highlight API elements and de-emphasize everything else in an existing view, but without inventing a local palette. Which LikeC4 customization would you propose?
evals.expected_output: A `style`-based customization using shared palette names (`primary`, `muted`, etc.) that highlights API elements while keeping context visible.
expectations: The response uses shared palette names (`primary`, `muted`, etc.) instead of hex codes.
The response uses `style` rules or `with` blocks to highlight API elements and de-emphasize the rest.
The response preserves structural context instead of hiding it completely.

evals.prompt: I want to enrich a template C2 view with an external link to internal spec docs and a stable drill-down to `c2_webapp_details`. Propose the customization block.
evals.expected_output: A customization block with `link https://... '...'`, a stable `navigateTo` to an existing view ID, and no scope drift beyond this skill.
expectations: The response adds an explicit `link https://... '...'`.
The response keeps or adds `navigateTo c2_webapp_details` on `mySystem.webapp`.
The response targets an existing view ID and stays in customization scope without rebuilding the whole view.

evals.prompt: On `c2_containers`, I want to highlight API elements, keep a stable drill-down to `c2_webapp_details`, and add an external link to internal docs. Which LikeC4 customization block should I use, and where does this skill stop?
evals.expected_output: The response combines style, `navigateTo`, and `link` within one customization scope, then delegates structural changes to the right skill.
expectations: The response uses view customization (`style`, `navigateTo`, `link`) and the shared palette, without rebuilding the entire view.
The response keeps or adds a stable `navigateTo c2_webapp_details`.
The response adds an explicit `link https://... '...'` compatible with the rest of the block.
The response delegates creation of a new structural or C3 view to `design-view`, not this skill.
